source.title: Supplementary material for Open Source Tools for Pressure Vessel Thermo-Mechanical Response and Safety Analysis
source.rights_boundary: The Zenodo record does not expose a machine-readable license field in the API response. Rights for each bundled input and derived data file must be checked before redistribution or validation reuse.

observed_contents.measurement_format: YAML validation blocks with time/value arrays

eligibility.reason: The archive contains cases and validation outcomes that overlap with already accessed public experiments and the numerical content was inspected after the existing protocols were frozen.

permitted_use: reproduce an external open-source solver result
identify missing geometry, boundary-condition or observation metadata
design a future pre-access holdout protocol
prohibited_use: calling the archive a new independent validation set
selecting runtime parameters from post-access comparisons
redistributing bundled files without rights review
claim_boundary: This intake strengthens reproducibility and model-development evidence only. It does not close Dickens, Schefer, PRESLHY, Grune or full-loop validation gates.
